summary: Generic preparation from the presets. Ask the agent to research this exact model for model-specific menus.

steps.title: Developer options and USB debugging
steps.why: Lets this app talk to the TV.
steps.how: Already done: the app is connected.

steps.title: Install system updates first
steps.why: Updates can switch removed apps back on. Update before we set things up, not after.
steps.how: Install any update, let the TV restart, then come back here.

steps.title: Sign in to a Google account
steps.why: Needed to install apps from the Play Store (Projectivy, Kodi, Aerial Views…).
steps.how: Sign in with the owner's Google account. The app never sees the password.

steps.title: Turn off usage reports and ad personalisation
steps.why: Stops Google collecting usage data and personalising ads on this TV.
steps.how: Switch Usage & diagnostics off. Then Settings › Privacy › Ads: delete the advertising ID or turn off personalisation.

steps.title: HDMI-CEC: one remote for connected devices
steps.why: Lets the TV remote control a soundbar, console or set-top box connected over HDMI.
steps.how: Turn it on if something is connected over HDMI; leave it off otherwise.

steps.title: Scan antenna / cable channels (free channels only)
steps.why: Only if you watch antenna or cable TV on this set. Scanning free channels only keeps paywalled channels out.
steps.how: Open the TV app, press the Settings (gear) button, Channel › Channel scan › Antenna or Cable. If there is a 'Scrambled channels' / 'Free only' option, choose free only. Start the scan. Follow the live screen if the menus look different.

steps.title: Picture: turn off motion smoothing
steps.why: Motion smoothing (MEMC) makes films look like soap operas and adds input lag.
steps.how: Set motion smoothing / MEMC off and use the Movie picture mode for films. Leave it on only if the owner likes it.

steps.title: Network standby (if available)
steps.why: Keeps the network on in standby so this app (and casting) can reach the TV without a power cycle.
steps.how: Turn it on if the menu exists on this model. It uses a little more power in standby.
